Widget is a fictional command line tool. This page exists only to exercise the Markdown loader and the chunker.

{/* This comment must not reach the chunk text. */}

## Install

Install the widget with the package manager of your choice. The installer places a single binary on your path.

```sh
widget install --global
```

### From source

Clone the repository, then build the binary with the release profile. Building from source takes a few minutes.

```sh
widget install --global
```

## Configure

<Note>
  Configuration lives in a plain text file next to your project. The widget reads it once at startup.
</Note>

```ts title="widget.config.ts"
// Widget configuration
## not a heading
export default {
  name: "demo",

  retries: 3,
  timeoutMs: 5000,
};
```

<Accordion
  title="Advanced options"
>
Set `<Widget />` options only when the defaults do not fit. Unknown keys raise an error at startup.
</Accordion>

<Badge label="beta" />

## Troubleshoot

If the widget exits early, run it again with verbose logging and read the last lines of the output.
